items.title: MEMORIES
items.quote: By David, to call to mind [a severe illness].
items.text: Recall the sufferings of the past from time to time and take to heart the lessons you learned from the experience.

items.w: יהוה אל בקצפך תוכיחני ובחמתך תיסרני
items.title: INTROSPECTION
items.quote: Hashem, do not rebuke me in Your anger nor chastise me in Your fury.
items.text: If you are suffering severe illness or pain, search your heart and ask yourself what sin you might have committed to warrant the anger of Hashem.

items.w: אין מתם בבשרי מפני זעמך אין שלום בעצמי מפני חטאתי
items.quote: There is no whole place on my body because of Your rage, no soundness of limbs because of my offense.

items.w: כי עונתי עברו ראשי כמשא כבד יכבדו ממני
items.title: CONFESSION
items.quote: For my sins have risen over my head. Like a heavy load, they are too heavy for me.
items.text: When you confess your sins, let each sin remind you of all the others. Don’t be easy on yourself but acknowledge all your failings. Then Hashem will forgive you.

items.w: נעויתי שחתי עד מאד כל היום קדר הלכתי
items.title: DEPRESSION
items.quote: I am bent and very stooped over. All day long I go about in a black depression.
items.text: If your troubles have brought you down and your mood is depressed, acknowledge you feelings to Hashem and He will surely comfort you.

items.title: ASPIRATION
items.quote: My Lord, before You is all my aspiration. My sighing is not concealed from You.
items.text: Recall your hopes of being close to Hashem, the relationship which you have sadly lost. Recall your yearning to be able see Him once again as the complete Master of your life and recall the happiness which you once found, but hope to regain again.

items.title: REGRET
items.quote: For I admit my iniquity; I worry because of my sin.
items.text: When you admit your sin, the fact that you offended your Creator and that you have distanced yourself from Him should weigh heavily upon you. You should ask yourself how you could have been so foolish.

items.w: אל תעזבני יהוה אלהי אל תרחק ממני
items.quote: Don’t forsake me, O Hashem, my G-d. Be not far from me.
